keeps.name: Charles Mill Lake Park - Main Camp
keeps.waterfront_evidence: Esri autumn satellite at 40.7660,-82.3746 (d=0.0012, 0.27 m/px) and MWCD Main Campground map chm2023_maincg.png: the renovated outer west row (map 112-121) and south loop's outer pads (134-139) back to the rip-rapped shore with the loop road on their INLAND side; pad ends ~8-27 m from the water across open grass and scattered trees, no road between. Not every row: further south the road runs along the shore, and the north half has a ~60 m treed strip. A 2020 leaf-off Wayback frame predates this row. --Claude
keeps.inclusion_evidence: AWH's saved calendar, read 2026-11-02 (Jul 6-20, 2027): 81 RV/Tent rows outside 400-612, posted max RV 30-45 ft on the 64 that post one, none under 30; MWCD map names the area 'Main Campground Area'.
keeps.note: Muskingum Watershed Conservancy District park on Charles Mill Lake, on the peninsula between the open lake and the marina, entered from SR 430 east of the causeway. The Beach area about 800 m south shares this road and gatehouse. Eagle Point is a separate campground across the water; the booking engine lists both by site number only (400-612 are Eagle Point). --Claude

sites.note: Total not written: MWCD says both '400+ campsites' and 'over 450 campsites in two campground locations', and Eagle Point's map labels 175 of them. Max is the highest posted in the saved calendar, whose 91 rows here are only what it listed for that window. Sites 8-39, on neither area map seen, are probably the Beach area, which has its own map. Tent-only: 18, 19, 219, 220, 262-265, 271, 274. Camper cabins 1-3 are numbered apart from sites 1-7.

facilities.note: Most RV sites are full hookup; 122-126 and 133-143 have water and electric only. Wi-Fi is at the Main Camp office, not the sites. The calendar marks ten sites priced like full hookups (325, 335, 343-345, 349, 359, 363, 367, 372) as 30-amp with no water or sewer, while the map shows them full hookup.

booking.note: Also by phone, (855) 822-6764. Seasonal lots and sites designated non-reservable aren't bookable; campers without a reservation are given a list of available lots.

fees.note: RV sites, Jul 6-20, 2027 only, and prices move within that window: water/electric $53-72; full hookup $55-87, of which the shoreline row 113-117 starts at $66. Tent-only sites $30-40. MWCD's 2024 brochure added $8 per reservation.

adds.name: Charles Mill Lake Park - Eagle Point
adds.waterfront_evidence: Esri autumn satellite at 40.7703,-82.3844 and Wayback 2020-02-22 WV03 leaf-off z19 at 40.7708,-82.3840: on the NW lobe (map 591-612) gravel pads face the SW shore with the loop road on their inland side; pad tips ~20-25 m from the water across open grass and scattered trees, no road between. Leaf-off at 40.7693,-82.3840 shows the SW-shore pads ~14 m from the shore through open-stemmed trees. Not every row: on the N lobe the road arc runs between the pads and the lake. Eagle Point map CHM20185009 is illustrative only. --Claude
adds.inclusion_evidence: AWH's saved calendar, read 2026-11-02 (Jul 6-20, 2027): 85 RV/Tent rows in 400-612, back-in where stated, posted max RV 25-40 ft on 76 of them, 8 unposted, one at 22 ft (575). MWCD's 'Charles Mill Lake Park Eagle Point Camp Area' map carries these numbers, all 'Electric Site'.
adds.note: Muskingum Watershed Conservancy District campground on Charles Mill Lake, entered from the north side of SR 430 west of the causeway, with a swimming pool for campers. Main Camp is the separate campground across the water; the booking engine lists sites by number only (400-612 are Eagle Point). --Claude

sites.note: Count is the numbered sites on MWCD's 2018 map (numbers run 402-612 with gaps). Max is the highest posted in the saved calendar, whose 101 rows here are only what it listed for that window. Site 575 posts 22 ft, under EKKO's length. Back-in where the calendar says; pull-throughs not stated.

facilities.note: Spigots among the sites. Wi-Fi is at the Eagle Point pavilion, not the sites.

booking.note: Also by phone, (855) 822-6764. Seasonal lots and sites designated non-reservable aren't bookable; campers without a reservation are given a list of available lots.

fees.note: RV sites, Jul 6-20, 2027 only, and prices move within that window: most sites $30-40; the outer-shore tier starts at $39 and tops out at $50 or $56. MWCD's 2024 brochure added $8 per reservation.
